output.title: Charming 1970s Villa with Private Garden and Double Garage
output.description:
Nestled in an established residential enclave, this distinguished villa from the 1970s exemplifies enduring craftsmanship and classic charm. Spanning 200 square meters, the home offers an inviting sanctuary with a stone facade and beautifully maintained private grounds that blend mature landscaping with functional outdoor living space.

Inside, the traditional living room welcomes you with rich wood paneling and an original stone fireplace, creating a warm ambiance that harmonizes with garden vistas through expansive windows. The property comprises four well-proportioned bedrooms and two bathrooms, thoughtfully arranged to balance privacy and family needs, enhanced by generous storage options throughout.

Step outside to a tranquil garden oasis featuring a spacious lawn bordered by mature trees and a comfortable patio perfect for alfresco dining. The double garage and dedicated parking spaces provide convenience and security, making this residence an ideal retreat that combines vintage elegance with everyday practicality.
